[id="deploying-inferenceservice-with-cached-model_{context}"]
= Deploy an InferenceService with a cached model

[role="_abstract"]
You can deploy an `InferenceService` that uses a locally cached model for faster startup.
When the `storageUri` in your `InferenceService` matches the `sourceModelUri` of a cached `LocalModelCache` resource, a mutating webhook automatically rewrites the URI to use the local persistent volume.
Using a cached model reduces startup time from 15-20 minutes to about one minute.

.Prerequisites

* A cluster administrator has enabled model cache and cached the model on the target nodes.
For more information, see xref:enabling-model-cache_{context}[Enable model cache] and xref:caching-a-model-for-faster-loading_{context}[Cache a model for faster loading].
* The `LocalModelCache` status shows `NodeDownloaded` for all target nodes.
* You know the `sourceModelUri` of the cached model.

.Procedure

. Create an `InferenceService` with a `storageUri` that matches the cached model:
+
[source,yaml]
----
apiVersion: serving.kserve.io/v1beta1
kind: InferenceService
metadata:
  name: <inference_service_name>
  namespace: <namespace>
spec:
  predictor:
    model:
      modelFormat:
        name: <model_format> <1>
      storageUri: "<model_uri>" <2>
      resources:
        limits:
          nvidia.com/gpu: "<gpu_count>"
        requests:
          nvidia.com/gpu: "<gpu_count>"
----
+
--
Where:

`<model_format>`:: Specifies the model format, such as `vLLM`.
`<model_uri>`:: Specifies the model URI that matches the `sourceModelUri` of the `LocalModelCache` resource, such as `hf://meta-llama/Llama-3-70B`.
--
+
You do not need annotations or additional YAML modifications.
The mutating webhook detects that a cached model matches the `storageUri` and rewrites the pod spec to mount the local persistent volume.

. Apply the resource:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc apply -f <inference_service_file>.yaml
----

. Monitor the pod startup:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get pods -n <namespace> -w
----
+
When using a cached model, the pod transitions to the `Running` state in about one minute instead of 15-20 minutes.
+
[NOTE]
====
If the `storageUri` does not match any cached model, the `InferenceService` falls back to downloading the model from remote storage.
The inference service functions normally, but with the standard download latency.
====

.Verification

* Verify that the pod spec shows a persistent volume claim mount instead of a storage initializer init container:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get pod <pod_name> -n <namespace> -o jsonpath='{.spec.volumes[*].persistentVolumeClaim}'
----
+
The output shows the persistent volume claim name associated with the cached model.
